claim_boundary: This audit rejects a retained-replay MIMO feasibility claim. It does not establish that the physical devices lack usable spatial rank; a new phase-continuous stereo acquisition is required.
formal_stop_reasons: No tracked raw audio or numeric capture array exists.
The qualified Pixel corpus has two microphone rows but only one independently driven speaker column.
The left/right tone-check design uses separate captures and therefore lacks common column phase.
Scalar response summaries omit a jointly estimated 2x2 H[k], repeat matrices, and receiver noise covariance.
The required five matrices in each of near-field, centered 3-ft, and lateral-offset 3-ft are absent.

rank11a_evidence_audit.finding: The accepted Pixel campaign is one MacBook left-speaker column observed on two Pixel inputs.
rejection_reasons: physical_cell.playback explicitly says built-in left speaker only
the ledger says raw manifests and captures are ignored local artifacts
no complex per-bin H[k], noise covariance, or repeat matrices are retained

rank11a_evidence_audit.finding: The route qualification establishes two direct Pixel microphone rows but only speaker channel 0.
rejection_reasons: scope.speaker_channels is [0]
